blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Measuring animal distance and motion in metric units underpins abundance estimation, morphometrics, and movement ecology, yet monocular video lacks metric scale and wildlife datasets lack metric ground truth. We present WildDepth 2, extending the synchronized RGB-LiDAR WildDepth dataset in three directions. (i) Imaging radar: 37 RGB-LiDAR-4D-radar sequences (19,716 frames) with per-point Doppler velocity and a measured error budget, to our knowledge the first imaging-radar wildlife recordings. (ii) Benchmarking: a frozen, checksummed hidden test set for RGB-only distance estimation and RGB+sparse-LiDAR depth completion, evaluated separately on animal and background pixels. (iii) Motion and tracking: metric 3D trajectories obtained by lifting 2D tracks using LiDAR, radar, or monocular depth. Across 48,723 animal frames, object-level radar calibration improves monocular depth over scene-level LiDAR calibration without requiring LiDAR at inference (AbsRel 0.120 vs. 0.198), although animal-level LiDAR remains more accurate (0.052). Across 431 tracks, once-per-track radar scaling reduces 3D position error four-fold (2.20 to 0.58 m) and distance-sampling detection-function bias from -13% to -2%, matching once-per-track LiDAR calibration. Transferring radar Doppler onto LiDAR produces motion masks 3.7 times denser than radar alone at 72% precision, reduces moving-animal LiDAR accumulation error by 37%, and estimates radial speed (r = 0.60), albeit with approximately 50% underestimation.
blocks.zh: 测量动物的距离和运动(以度量单位计)是丰度估计、测尸和运动生态的基础,但单视视频缺乏度量尺度,野生动物数据集缺乏度量地面真理。 我们提出Wild Depth 2,将同步的RGB-LiDAR Wild Depth数据集向三个方向扩展. (一)成像雷达:37个RGB-LiDAR-4D-雷达序列(19,716帧),每点多普勒速度和测量误差预算,据我们所知,这是第一次成像雷达野生动物录音。 (二)基准化:用于RGB唯一距离估计和RGB+sparse-LiDAR深度完成的冷冻,验收的隐藏测试集,分别对动物和背景像素进行评估. (三)运动和跟踪:通过使用LiDAR,雷达,或单体深度的2D轨道升空获得的度量三维轨距. 在48,723个动物框架上,物体级雷达校准比场景级LiDAR校准提高了单体深度,无需LiDAR推断(AbsRel 0.120 vs.0.198),不过动物级LiDAR仍然更准确(0.052). 穿越431个轨道,一次逐轨雷达缩放将3D位置误差减少4倍(2.20至0.58米),远距离采样检测功能偏差从-13%降至-2%,匹配一次逐轨LiDAR校准. 将雷达多普勒转移到LiDAR上,产生的运动罩密度比雷达高3.7倍,精度为72%,将移动动物的LiDAR积存误差减少37%,并估计射线速度(r=0.60),尽管低估了大约50%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Non-invasive monitoring of animals is increasingly vital as biodiversity faces unprecedented pressure from habitat loss, poaching, and climate change [ 10 , 52 ] .
Computer vision has made detection, species classification, and individual identification routine at scale [ 3 , 20 , 14 ] , and multi-object tracking now links detections into trajectories in video [ 61 , 49 , 38 ] .
Many of the questions ecologists ask of these trajectories, however, are metric : how far away is the animal (the input to distance-sampling abundance estimates [ 8 , 21 ] ), how large is it (body condition, sexual dimorphism, population structure [ 13 ] ), and how fast and where does it move (behaviour, energetics).
The overwhelming majority of wildlife imagery – camera traps, hand-held and aerial video [ 3 , 19 , 29 ] – is monocular RGB and carries no metric scale.
Modern monocular depth estimators (MDEs) recover plausible relative geometry, but whether their metric outputs can be trusted for a distant, deformable animal in unstructured terrain has been difficult to test, because animal datasets do not contain metric ground truth.
blocks.zh:
对动物的非侵入性监测越来越重要,因为生物多样性面临前所未有的生境丧失、偷猎和气候变化的压力[10,52]。
计算机视觉使探测、物种分类和个人识别在尺度上成为常规[3、20、14],多物体跟踪现在将探测与视频中的轨迹联系起来[61、49、38]。
然而,生态学家对这些轨迹提出的许多问题都是衡量的:动物距离多远(对远距离取样丰度估计的投入[8,21]),体积多大(身体状况,性畸形,人口结构[13]),运动速度多快,在哪里(行为,能量).
绝大多数野生生物影像 — — 摄像头、手持和空中录像[3、19、29] — — 是单一的RGB,没有尺度。
现代单极深度估测器(MDEs)恢复了可信的相对几何,但是它们的度量输出是否能够被信任为一个在无结构地形的遥远,可变形的动物,一直难以测试,因为动物数据集并不包含度量的地面真理.

blocks.en:
In the conference version of this work [ 1 ] we introduced WildDepth , a synchronized RGB–LiDAR dataset collected at three ecologically distinct sites including Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park (South Africa), Bubye Valley Conservancy (Zimbabwe), and Longleat Safari Park (UK), and used it to show that off-the-shelf MDEs degrade sharply at range while sparse LiDAR anchoring roughly halves their metric error.
LiDAR, however, is expensive, power-consuming, and mechanically delicate, which limits how widely such a rig can be deployed; and neither LiDAR nor a single RGB frame measures motion directly, which is exactly the quantity a tracker must reason about.
blocks.zh:
在会议版本中, 我们引入了 Wild Depth, 一个同步的 RGB-LiDAR 数据集, 收集到三个生态上不同的地点,
然而,LiDAR是昂贵的,耗电的,机械化的精密,这限制了这种钻机的部署范围;而LiDAR和单一的RGB帧测量直接运动,这恰恰是追踪器必须说明的数量.

blocks.en:
Millimetre-wave 4D imaging radar offers a complementary trade-off that has transformed automotive perception [ 9 , 44 , 43 ] : it is inexpensive, low-power, robust to dust, rain and darkness, and it measures each return’s radial velocity through the Doppler effect.
Radar–camera fusion for depth, detection, and tracking is now an active area in driving [ 35 , 30 , 41 , 57 ] , but the targets there are large, rigid, and retro-reflective.
Wildlife inverts these conditions: animals possess small, low-reflectivity, non-rigid bodies whose Doppler signature is dominated by limb motion, observed at tens of metres superimposed on natural clutter.
Whether radar transfers to this regime is, to our knowledge, untested.
blocks.zh:
微波四维成像雷达提供了一种互补的权衡,它改变了汽车感知[9,44,43]:它价格低廉,功率低,坚固到尘埃,雨和黑暗,它通过多普勒效应测量每个返回的射线速度.
雷达-摄像头聚变,用于深度、探测和跟踪,现在是驱动[35、30、41、57]的活跃区域,但目标大、僵硬、反射。
野生生物颠倒了这些条件:动物拥有小型、低反射力、非硬体,其多普勒的特征以四肢运动为主,在数十米处超度于自然杂质上。
据我们所知,向这一政权转移的雷达是否未经测试。

blocks.en:
This paper, WildDepth-v2 , extends WildDepth to address both gaps, a cheaper source of metric scale, and a direct measurement of motion and transforms the dataset into a benchmark for metric animal perception over time.
Our contributions are: The first RGB–LiDAR–radar wildlife recordings (Sec. 3.2 ). We add a synchronized Altos V2 4D imaging radar to the Longleat subset: 37 sequences and 19,716 frames in which RGB, LiDAR, and radar are all present, with per-point Doppler velocity and radar cross-section. We release the radar → \rightarrow LiDAR extrinsic together with a measured error budget (radar–LiDAR timing, and a strongly anisotropic extrinsic residual), rather than assuming one. A frozen, held-out WildDepth benchmark (Sec. 4 ). A checksummed hidden test set drawn from unreleased footage, with two tracks, first RGB-only camera-to-animal distance and RGB+sparse-LiDAR dense depth and second a scorer that separates animal from background error, and a documented construction recipe and defect list. Radar as a metric anchor and a motion sensor (Secs. 5.3 – 5.5 ). Object-level radar range calibrates monocular depth better than scene-level LiDAR calibration without LiDAR at inference (AbsRel 0.120 vs. 0.198 on 20,869 test animal frames), though not as well as LiDAR on the animal. Doppler, transferred to the co-registered LiDAR through anisotropic association, yields motion masks 3.7 × \times denser than radar alone at 72% precision, and can gate multi-second LiDAR accumulation so that moving animals are not smeared. Metric motion and tracking tasks (Sec. 5.6 ). We lift 2D animal tracks to metric 3D trajectories using LiDAR, radar, or monocular depth and evaluate position, speed, jitter and distance-sampling bias. Scaling monocular depth by radar once per track matches a once-per-track LiDAR calibration (0.58 vs. 0.52 m position error) and cuts the detection-function bias of monocular depth from − - 13% to − - 2%. An objective map of radar’s operating envelope for wildlife (Sec. 5.7 ), by including negative results we believe are useful to others: per-pixel radar depth fails because of a 1.8 m vertical extrinsic residual; radar does not extend coverage or see through vegetation in our data; Doppler tracks radial animal speed but under-reads it by half; and per-frame extrinsic refinement can drift far enough to corrupt LiDAR ground truth.
blocks.zh:
本文"Wild Depth-v2"扩展了Wild Depth,以解决这两个差距,一个更便宜的度量尺度来源,以及直接测量运动,并将数据集转化为一个随着时间的推移的度量动物感知的基准.
我们的贡献是: 首张RGB–LiDAR–radar野生动物录音(第3.2节). 我们在长叶子集中增加了同步的Altos V2 4D成像雷达:37个序列和19,716帧,其中RGB,LiDAR和雷达全部存在,每点多普勒速度和雷达截面. 我们释放了雷达 ~ 右侧的 LiDAR 外观, 加上一个测量的误差预算( 雷达 - LiDAR 时程, 以及强烈的异构外观残余), 而不是假设一个。 一个冻结的、被搁置的野生深度基准(第4节)。 一个从未释放的镜头中抽取的检查总和的隐藏测试集,有两个音轨,第一个只有RGB的相机对动物距离和RGB+sparse-LiDAR密集深度,第二个是将动物与背景错误区分开的计分器,以及一个有记录的构造食谱和缺陷列表. 雷达作为度量锚和运动传感器(Secs. 5.3 – 5.5). 物体级的雷达范围比场景级的LiDAR校准更好,没有LiDAR推论(AbsRel 0120 vs. 0198 on 20,869 test animal frames),虽然不及动物上的LiDAR. 多普勒通过异构协会转至联合注册的LiDAR,以72%的精度产生运动口罩3.7×\时数比雷达更密集,并且可以锁定多秒的LiDAR积聚,以免移动动物被涂抹. 计量运动和跟踪任务(第5.6节). 我们利用LiDAR、雷达或单体深度将2D动物轨迹提升到测量3D轨迹,并评估位置、速度、焦距和远距离取样偏差。 每轨一次通过雷达放大单倍深度,匹配一次双倍轨距的LiDAR校准(0.58对0.52米位置误差),并将单倍深度的检测功能偏差从−-13%降至−-2%. 雷达对野生动物的操作信封的客观地图(Sec. 5.7),将负面结果列入,我们认为对其他人有用:每像素雷达深度因1.8米垂直外部残留而失效;雷达在数据中没有扩大覆盖范围或通过植被看到;多普勒跟踪动物的射线速度,但读数不足一半;每帧外部精细可漂移到足以腐蚀LiDAR地面真相的程度。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Wildlife datasets. Camera traps, aerial surveys, and hand-held video have produced large animal datasets for detection, identification, and behaviour recognition [ 47 , 3 ] .
MammAlps [ 19 ] , LoTE [ 31 ] , KABR [ 26 ] and BaboonLand [ 15 ] provide video benchmarks for behaviour; Animal Kingdom [ 42 ] and MammalNet [ 11 ] capture species appearance from internet video; ChimpACT [ 37 ] and the Meerkat dataset [ 48 ] target tracking and behaviour of a single species.
These datasets are RGB-only (occasionally with audio) and contain no metric geometry.
WildPose [ 40 ] demonstrated long-range RGB–LiDAR capture of wild animals, and WildDepth [ 1 ] turned it into a multi-site dataset.
WildDepth-v2 adds imaging radar and a held-out benchmark (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
野生动物数据集. 相机陷阱、空中勘测和手持录像产生了大型动物数据集,用于探测、识别和行为识别[47、3]。
MammAlps [19],LoTE [31],KABR [26]和BaboonLand [15]提供行为视频基准;动物王国[42]和MammalNet[11]从互联网视频中捕捉物种的出现;ChimpACT[37]和Meerkat数据集[48]目标跟踪和单一物种的行为.
这些数据集只有RGB(偶尔带有音频),没有包含度量几何.
WildPose [40] 演示了对野生动物的远程RGB–LiDAR捕捉,Wild Depth [1] 将其转化为多站数据集.
Wild Depth-v2增加了成像雷达和一个搁置基准(表1)。

blocks.en:
Animal tracking. Tracking-by-detection with Kalman-filter motion models and IoU or appearance association, SORT [ 5 ] , DeepSORT [ 56 ] , ByteTrack [ 61 ] , is the default for animals in video, alongside laboratory trackers for collectives [ 49 ] and pose trackers [ 38 , 59 , 39 ] .
In driving, tracking has moved to metric 3D space [ 55 , 60 ] and is scored with CLEAR-MOT and HOTA [ 4 , 36 ] .
Animal tracking in the wild remains almost entirely 2D because metric 3D ground truth has been unavailable; WildDepth-v2 provides it through LiDAR and adds per-point radial velocity from radar.
blocks.zh:
动物追踪. 与卡尔曼-过滤器运动模型和IoU或外观关联的跟踪-逐一检测,SORT [5],DeepSORT [56],字节追踪[61],是视频中动物的默认,与实验室跟踪器一起为集体[49],并姿势跟踪器[38,59,39].
在驾驶方面,跟踪已移到公尺3D空间[55,60],并被CLEAR-MOT和HOTA[4,36]打分.
野生动物的追踪几乎完全保持2D,因为没有测量到3D的地面真相;Wild Depth-v2通过LiDAR提供,并从雷达上增加每个点的射线速度.

blocks.en:
Monocular depth estimation. MDE has advanced from self-supervised CNNs [ 27 ] to large transformers DPT [ 45 ] , Depth Anything [ 58 ] , Depth Pro [ 7 ] , and metric geometry models such as MoGe-2 [ 54 ] evaluated mainly on driving and indoor benchmarks [ 28 , 51 ] .
Wildlife scenes are unstructured, their subjects are non-rigid and often tens of metres away, and they are under-represented in training data; recent work has begun lifting monocular animal observations to metric 3D [ 50 , 2 , 62 ] .
We provide the metric ground truth to test such methods and study which sparse sensor can supply the missing scale.
blocks.zh:
单体深度估计. MDE已经从自我监督的CNN[27]发展到大型变压器 DPT[45],深度任何东西[58],深度Pro[7],以及像MoGe-2[54]等测量几何模型主要在驱动和室内基准上评价[28,51].
野生生物场景结构不整齐,其主体为非刚性,且常在数十米外,在训练数据中代表不足;近期的工作开始将单体动物观测提升到公尺3D[50,2,62].
我们提供了衡量底线的真相,以测试这些方法,并研究哪些稀疏的传感器能够提供缺失的尺度。

blocks.en:
Radar for depth, motion, and tracking. Automotive radar datasets such as nuScenes [ 9 ] , View-of-Delft [ 44 ] , K-Radar [ 43 ] enabled radar–camera fusion for depth completion [ 30 , 35 ] , detection [ 41 ] , and Doppler-aware tracking of dynamic objects [ 57 ] .
Doppler also gives platform ego-motion [ 25 ] , and micro-Doppler from limbs and rotating parts is a well-known signature of articulated targets [ 12 ] .
All of this work targets vehicles and pedestrians on roads.
Wildlife inverts the assumptions: small, low-reflectivity, deformable targets at long range, in natural clutter, with Doppler dominated by gait.
We are not aware of prior work that evaluates imaging radar on animals.
blocks.zh:
雷达用于深度、运动和跟踪 汽车雷达数据集,如nuScenes [9], View-of-Delft [44],K-Radar [43] 使得雷达-相机聚变能够深度完成 [30,35],探测 [41],以及Doppler-aware 动态物体跟踪 [57].
多普勒还给出了平台自负-运动[25],来自四肢和旋转部位的微多普勒是明确目标[12]的著名标志.
所有这些工作都针对公路上的车辆和行人。
野生动物颠倒了假设:小,低反射,长距离变形的目标,在自然杂乱中,多普勒以步态为主.
我们不知道以前对动物成像雷达进行评估的工作。

blocks.en: 3 The WildDepth-v2 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 荒野深度- v2 数据集

blocks.en:
WildDepth-v2 consists of the RGB–LiDAR collection of WildDepth [ 1 ] (Sec. 3.1 ), a new radar-equipped subset (Sec. 3.2 ), and a new held-out test set (Sec. 4 ).
Figure 1 gives an overview.
blocks.zh:
Wild Depth-v2由RGB–LiDAR收集的Wild Depth [1](第3.1节),一个新的雷达装备子集(第3.2节),以及一个新的搁置测试集(第4节)组成.

blocks.en:
WildDepth comprises three subsets collected in 2022 and 2025 in wild habitats and a semi-controlled safari park (Table 2 ).
The Kgalagadi subset (Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park, South Africa, December 2022) was captured over 13 days with the vehicle-mounted WildPose system [ 40 ] , a zoom-lens camera with a Livox TELE-15 LiDAR, and covers 26 species, apex predators such as lion, cheetah and leopard, and herbivores such as springbok and gemsbok, at 12–140 m.
The Bubye subset (Bubye Valley Conservancy, Zimbabwe, June 2025) used a custom 4K RGB camera with a Livox Mid-70, in mobile (vehicle window) and stationary configurations, over mopane and acacia woodland; it covers six species at 5–50 m.
The Longleat subset (Longleat Safari Park, UK, July 2025) covers ten species in open enclosures at 5–50 m, recorded with an RGB camera and a Livox Mid-70 LiDAR (first rig) and, in parallel, with a second vehicle-mounted rig that additionally carries the imaging radar described below.
The curated release totals 202,941 frames in species-balanced “snippets”, and the full raw recordings are also released.

Bubye子集(Bubaye Valley Conservancy,津巴布韦,2025年6月)使用一台定制的4K RGB照相机,装有Livox Mid-70,在移动(车辆窗口)和固定布置中,在树干和阿卡西亚林地之上;它覆盖6个物种5–50米.

The LiDARs are prism-scanning time-of-flight sensors rated at ≈ \approx 2 cm ( 1 ​ σ 1\sigma ) range precision that stays roughly constant over our operating distances [ 34 , 33 , 32 ] ; the WildPose system was independently validated at a median absolute error of 45.2 mm at 160 m [ 40 ] .
LiDAR runs at 10 Hz and the cameras at 30 Hz; each LiDAR scan is paired with the camera frame nearest in time ( ± \pm 10 ms).
Animals were detected with MegaDetector [ 3 ] , tracked with ByteTrack [ 61 ] , and every track was verified for species and behaviour.

blocks.en: 3.2 RGB–LiDAR–Radar Subset (new)
blocks.zh: 3.2 RGB–LiDAR–Radar 子集(新)

blocks.en:
On the second rig we rigidly co-mounted an Altos V2 4D imaging radar with the LiDAR and an Intel RealSense colour camera ( 640 × 480 640{\times}480 ).
Per frame, the radar returns a sparse point cloud in which each point carries its Cartesian position ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) , its radial (Doppler) velocity h h in m/s, its signal strength (a radar-cross-section proxy, s s ), and a coarse three-way motion class v ∈ { − 1 , 0 , + 1 } v\in\{-1,0,+1\} ; we recommend the continuous h h , since the motion class under-counts moving returns by roughly an order of magnitude on our data.
Angular resolution is about 1.38 ∘ 1.38^{\circ} in azimuth and 1.43 ∘ 1.43^{\circ} in elevation.
A typical frame holds 679 valid returns (median over sequences) against 19,390 LiDAR points; returns extend beyond 200 m, but the animals we study lie within 55 m.
On animals, the radar returns associated with a detection (Sec. 4.3 ) number a median of 45, 28 and 22 at 5–20, 20–30 and 30–55 m, against 109, 54 and 47 single-sweep LiDAR points inside the animal’s mask (Fig. 2 ); many of the associated radar returns come from ground and background seen past the animal. Radar is therefore much sparser on the animal than the LiDAR it accompanies, but it measures range and velocity directly.

blocks.en:
Radar was recorded on two days.
On the second day (July 8) it is healthy in all 37 snippets; on the first day (July 7) the sensor stopped publishing and the recorder repeated a stale message, so every radar frame within a snippet is byte-identical.
We detected this with a per-snippet checksum test and exclude July 7 radar from the release and all experiments.
The radar subset thus contains 37 snippets, 22,348 radar frames, and 19,716 frames with RGB, LiDAR and radar all present (one LiDAR file is empty and excluded).

雷达记录在两天内。

我们通过每片检查和测试检测到了这个结果,并将7月7日的雷达排除在释放和所有实验之外.
因此,雷达子集包含37个片段,22,348个雷达帧,以及19,716个带有RGB,LiDAR和雷达的帧全部存在(一个LiDAR文件是空的,不包括在内).

blocks.en:
All three streams share one global 10 Hz frame index, so radar, LiDAR and RGB with the same index form a synchronized triple; the index is also the key that links the second rig recordings to the released Longleat snippets.
Radar messages are matched to the nearest LiDAR timestamp, and we release the per-frame offset.
The mean absolute radar–LiDAR offset is 16.8 ms (95th percentile 31.5 ms), with rare dropouts up to 350 ms that we flag (Fig. 10 ); at a walking speed of 5 m/s a 20 ms offset corresponds to 10 cm of displacement.

blocks.en: The LiDAR → \rightarrow camera extrinsic of the second rig rig was solved once per sequence (the anchor ) and then refined per frame by joint correspondence and gradient optimization (intrinsics frozen). The per-frame refinement drifts: by a median of 2.1 ∘ from the anchor and by up to 25 ∘ in some sequences, which is implausible for a rigid mount. An independent check – the spread of LiDAR depth inside SAM2 animal masks, which grows when background leaks into the mask – favours the anchor wherever the drift exceeds 5 ∘ (in-mask IQR 0.83 vs. 1.27 m; 116 vs. 50 LiDAR points on the animal), and the two agree below 1 ∘ . We therefore use the anchor extrinsic for all ground truth. The depth maps shipped with the public second rig record were projected with the per-frame extrinsics and are affected in the high-drift sequences; we release re-projected maps with WildDepth-v2.
blocks.zh: 第二套钻机的LiDAR → 右旋相机外观,每组(锚)被解决一次,然后通过联合通信与梯度优化(静态冻结)对每组帧进行精制。 每帧精细度漂移:从锚上以2.1 QQ的中位数表示,在某些序列中以25 QQ的中位数表示,对于一个刚性挂载来说,这是不可思议的. 独立检查 — LiDAR深度在SAM2动物口罩内部的传播, 当背景泄露到口罩中时会逐渐扩大 — 在漂移超过5QQ(在IQR 0.83对1.27m;116对50LiDAR对动物的点数)的地方偏好锚, 两者在1QQ以下达成一致. 因此,我们利用外部的锚来证明一切真相。 与公共第二钻机记录一起运送的深度图是用每帧外壳投射的,并受到高推力序列的影响;我们发布了使用Wild Depth-v2重新投射的地图.

blocks.en:
The radar → \rightarrow LiDAR extrinsic is a single rigid transform, because the two sensors share one mount; it was initialized by aligning static structure and refined manually on one sequence.
We measured its residual on 827k static radar returns across all 37 sequences, matching each to the nearest accumulated-LiDAR point in the ground plane, and found it strongly anisotropic : a median of 0.10 m in range and azimuth (75th percentile 0.26 m) but 1.84 m in elevation (Fig. 10 ), a direct consequence of the radar’s few elevation bins.
This anisotropy governs every radar experiment in this paper: projecting a radar return into the image can move it by several animal heights vertically, so we always associate radar to an animal at the object level, the robust median range of the radar returns whose projection falls in the animal’s box and never per pixel. We release the extrinsic, the residual analysis, and the association code.
blocks.zh:
雷达 →\ 右旋LiDAR 外观是一个单一的刚性变换,因为两个传感器共用一个挂载;它通过对齐静态结构而初始化,并在一个序列上手动改进.
我们测量了所有37个序列的827k静态雷达返回的剩余量, 将其与地面平面中最接近的累积点相匹配, a 中位数为0.10米的射程和方位角(75百分位数0.26米),但高程为1.84米(图10),这是雷达很少高程箱的直接后果。
本文中每个雷达实验都受这种异同性制约:将雷达投射回图像可以垂直地通过几处动物高度移动,所以我们总是将雷达与物体级的动物联系起来,雷达的强中位数范围是返回的,其投影落到动物的盒子里,从不逐像素. 我们发布外侧分析 剩余分析 和关联代码

blocks.en: 4.1 Hidden Test Set (T1, T2)

blocks.en:
A benchmark built from released data invites overfitting, so we built a hidden test set from unreleased Longleat MorphoCam footage recorded between released snippets.
Construction, in order: (1) exclude every released snippet range with a guard band of ± \pm 300 frames; (2) keep only frames where the rig is static, measured by phase correlation against a running reference ( ≤ \leq 0.2 px at 1/8 scale), so that LiDAR can be accumulated; (3) accumulate 11 LiDAR sweeps as dense ground truth; (4) detect animals with MegaDetector (confidence ≥ \geq 0.5) and segment them with SAM2 [ 46 ] ; (5) keep detections whose ground-truth distance lies in 5–50 m; (6) drop masks whose in-mask LiDAR depth has an inter-quartile range above 3 m, which removes detections corrupted by background leakage. Two scenes with a fence across the lens (121 frames) were removed entirely.
blocks.zh:
一个基于发布数据建立的基准邀请过度调整,所以我们从发布片段之间录制的未发布Longleat MorphoCam镜头中构建了一套隐藏的测试集.
构造,顺序:(1) 排除每个释放的片段范围,护带为±\pm 300帧;(2) 仅将钻机静态的片段保留下来,以相位关联度比运行参照值(±\leq 0.2 px,比例为1/8)来衡量,以便积累LiDAR;(3) 积累11个LiDAR扫描作为密集的地面真象;(4) 检测使用巨型探测器的动物(自信±\geq 0.5),并将其与SAM2 [46]分开;(5) 将地面-真象距离为5-50米的探测器保留下来;(6) 降下遮罩,其LiDAR深度的方位距超过3米,从而消除因背景渗漏而损坏的探测器. 镜头对面设有栅栏的两个场景(121帧)被完全拆除.

blocks.en:
The result has 13 scenes, 352 frames with 510 animal detections for Track A (T1), and 902 frames for Track B (T2), plus a public validation split (137 frames, 298 detections).
The set is frozen: an SHA-256 manifest covers all 4,046 files, the scorer refuses to run if the reference no longer matches it, and two independently verified copies are kept.
The current version (v1.3) merges the sparsely populated 5–10 m bin into 10–20 m (Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
结果有13个场景,352帧为轨迹A(T1)的510个动物探测器,902帧为轨迹B(T2)的探测器,外加一个公开验证分(137帧,298检测器).
套装被冻结:一份SHA-256清单覆盖所有4,046个文件,如果参考文献不再匹配,计分员拒绝运行,并保存了两份独立核实的副本.
目前版本(v1.3)将人口稀少的5–10 m bin合并为10–20 m(图4).

blocks.en:
The hidden set is frame-disjoint from the release (minimum gap 301 frames against all 81,856 released MorphoCam frames), but not session-disjoint: 48% of its frames lie within one minute of a released snippet (median 58 s), and a second, public rig recorded the same enclosures on the same days.
It therefore measures in-domain performance, not cross-site transfer.
Its RGB–LiDAR extrinsic is one static calibration per record; we attempted automatic per-scene refinement and rejected it after independent validation (Sec. 5.7 ), and instead rely on the mask-coherence filter of step (6), which reduced the median in-mask depth IQR from 0.84 to 0.65 m at the cost of 140 detections.
blocks.zh:
隐藏的套装与发布时的帧离合(与所有81,856个发布时的MorphoCam帧相比最小的间隙301帧),但不是会话离合:其48%的帧位于发布片段(中间线58s)的1分钟内,第二台公共钻机在同一天录制了相同的封装.
因此,它衡量的是域内业绩,而不是跨地点转让。
其RGB–LiDAR外观是每张记录一个静态校准;我们尝试了每层自动校准,并在独立验证后予以拒绝(Sec. 5.7),转而依靠步骤(6)的口罩协调滤波器,将任务内中位深度IQR从0.84米降低到0.65米,代价为140次检测.

These returns mix the animal with ground and background seen past it, so their median is biased far.
We compare four LiDAR-free estimators of the animal’s range r b r_{b} – the median, the nearest cluster of ≥ \geq 3 returns within 2 m, the densest such cluster, and the median of the returns within ± \pm 35% of the MDE’s own metric prediction, and select one on development sequences (Sec. 5.3 ).
The anchor pairs { ( D b mde , r b ) } \{(D^{\text{mde}}_{b},r_{b})\} , with D b mde D^{\text{mde}}_{b} the robust median MDE depth in the animal mask, are used to fit the per-frame map: affine with two or more anchors, scale-only with one.
Associating at the object level is what makes radar usable at all: per-pixel association inherits the 1–2 m elevation error of the extrinsic.

A single LiDAR sweep is too sparse on a distant animal, so dense depth is obtained by accumulating sweeps over a short window and fusing them with an MDE prior (MoGe-2) via RANSAC scale-shift alignment on SAM2-masked points, with a Sobel boundary filter against telephoto edge artefacts [ 18 , 6 , 23 ] .
Accumulation is valid only for still animals; a moving animal is smeared.
Our gated variant marks an animal as moving when at least three of the LiDAR points in its mask inherit | h | > 0.5 |h|>0.5 m/s through the Doppler transfer and, for those animals only, uses the current sweep alone. We evaluate on static-platform frames, where past sweeps are already registered, with windows of 5, 15 and 30 sweeps, and compare against a gate driven by optical flow.

2D tracks are formed by SORT-style IoU association [ 5 ] of MegaDetector detections with Hungarian matching (IoU ≥ \geq 0.3, tracks kept alive for 5 frames).
Each observation is back-projected at its mask centroid with a depth from one of the sources – LiDAR (reference), MoGe-2, UC or LC-scene per frame, a LiDAR scale fixed on the first frame of the track, object-level radar range, or MoGe-2 scaled by the median radar/MoGe-2 ratio over the track – and every trajectory is smoothed with the same constant-velocity Kalman filter and RTS smoother [ 22 ] .

每一次观测都是在它的面具中间机器人上进行反投射,深度来自其中一个来源——LiDAR(参考),MoGe-2,UC或LC-scene每帧,轨道第一帧固定的LiDAR比例,物体级雷达范围,或MoGe-2在轨道上由中位雷达/MoGe-2比例缩放——每个轨迹均采用相同的恒速卡尔曼滤波器和RTS平滑器[22].

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en:
We first re-establish the RGB–LiDAR baselines on the released data and the hidden test (Secs. 5.1 – 5.2 ), then study what radar adds for metric scale (Sec. 5.3 ) and motion (Secs. 5.4 – 5.5 ), evaluate metric 3D tracking (Sec. 5.6 ), and close with radar’s operating envelope (Sec. 5.7 ).
LiDAR is the metric reference throughout.
All radar-subset experiments run on every synchronized July-8 frame (19,716 frames): MegaDetector V6 (confidence ≥ \geq 0.3), SAM2.1 masks, and MoGe-2 depth are computed once per frame, and every number is produced by a released script ( Code availability ).
Ground truth uses the anchor LiDAR → \rightarrow camera extrinsic of each sequence (Sec. 3.2 ).

我们首先在释放的数据和隐藏试验(Sec.5.1 – 5.2)上重新建立RGB-LiDAR基线,然后研究雷达为度量尺度(Sec 5.3)和运动(Sec 5.4 – 5.5)增加什么,评价度量3D跟踪(Sec 5.6),并关闭雷达的操作信封(Sec 5.7).
LiDAR是整个衡量参考。
所有雷达子集实验都运行在每个同步的7-8帧(19,716帧): Mega Detectionor V6(自信\\ geq 0. 3), SAM2.1 口罩,和 MoGe-2 深度每帧计算一次,每个数字由发布脚本(代码可用性)产生.

blocks.en: 5.1 Monocular Distance to Animals (T1)

Table 4 summarizes the results.

Per-frame LiDAR calibration roughly halves RMSE for every model and raises δ < 1.25 \delta{<}1.25 to 0.50–0.79.

blocks.en:
Track B asks for dense depth from RGB and one raw LiDAR sweep.
Table 6 shows that the split into animal and background pixels matters: a nearest-neighbour fill of the sweep is 35% worse on animals (RMSE 6.10 m) than on background (4.51 m), and aligning MoGe-2 to the sweep improves the animals (5.33 m) while leaving the background unchanged.
Neither baseline closes the animal gap, which is the headroom the track is designed to measure.

blocks.en: 5.3 Radar as a Metric Anchor (T3)
blocks.zh: 5.3 雷达作为测量仪(T3)

blocks.en:
Can object-level radar range replace LiDAR as the anchor that gives monocular depth its metric scale?
We compare anchor sources on 48,723 animals in 18,879 frames (Table 7 ).
All methods are scored against the same held-out ground truth: each mask’s LiDAR points are split at random, one half defines the ground truth and the other half is the LC-box anchor, so no LiDAR baseline is scored on its own anchor points.
The LiDAR-free radar range estimator was chosen on odd-numbered (development) sequences (Table 8 ) and all results are reported on the even-numbered (test) sequences.

我们比较了48,723种动物在18,879帧中的锚源(表7)。
所有方法都针对相同的被搁置的地面真理进行打分:每个面具的LiDAR点是随机分拆的,一半定义地面真理,另一半是LC-box锚,因此没有LiDAR基线在自己的锚点上打分.
LiDAR无线雷达测距仪是在奇数(开发)序列(表8)上选择的,所有结果都报告在偶数(测试)序列上.

blocks.en:
Four findings follow.
(i) Radar is usable only at the object level. Per-pixel radar anchors (RC-pixel) are worse than no anchor at all (AbsRel 0.48), because the elevation error places returns on the wrong image rows.
(ii) Object-level radar beats scene-level LiDAR calibration and the MDE alone, without LiDAR. RC-box reaches AbsRel 0.120 (median error 0.60 m) against 0.198 for the scene-level LiDAR calibration used in WildDepth and 0.146 for MoGe-2’s own metric output.
A scene-wide affine fit is dominated by ground and background points, which is why it can hurt a model that is already metric.
(iii) Where radar sees the animal, its range is nearly as good as LiDAR. On the 15,196 test animals with an associated radar range (73%), that range alone has AbsRel 0.064, against 0.144 for MoGe-2 and 0.046 for held-out LiDAR on the same animals.
The best estimator gates the returns in the box with MoGe-2’s metric prediction ( ± \pm 35%) and is therefore an RGB+radar method; a radar-only estimator (nearest range cluster) reaches a 4.2% median relative error at 90% coverage but has a heavy tail.
(iv) Radar does not replace LiDAR. Box-level LiDAR remains more than twice as accurate (0.052 vs. 0.120), radar’s advantage vanishes beyond 30 m (Fig. 6 ), and animals without their own radar anchor inherit a frame-level fit that is much less accurate (leave-own-anchor-out AbsRel 0.239).
We also note a correction to an earlier analysis of these data: the anchor that snaps radar to LiDAR (last row) needs LiDAR at inference and does not replicate at scale (AbsRel 0.572).
The conclusions are unchanged when the per-frame extrinsic is used for ground truth instead of the anchor extrinsic.
blocks.zh:
以下四个调查结果。
(i) 雷达仅可在物体一级使用。 每像素雷达锚(RC-pixel)比完全没有锚(AbsRel 048)更差,因为高程误差将返回置于错误的图像行上.
(二)物体级雷达击败场景级的LiDAR校准和单MDE,没有LiDAR. RC-box达到AbsRel 0.120(中间误差0.60米),而用于Wild Depth的场景级LiDAR校准则达到0.198,而用于MoGe-2本身的度量输出则达到0.146.
场景全景的配角以地面和背景点为主,这就是它会伤害一个已经是度量模型的原因.
(三)雷达看到该动物时,其射程接近LiDAR. 在15,196个具有相关雷达射程(73%)的试验动物上,仅该射程就有AbsRel 0.064,而MoGe-2的试验动物为0.144,在同一动物上被扣留的LiDAR为0.046。
最佳估计器用 MoGe-2 的度量预测(±\pm 35%)打开了盒子中的返回,因此是一种RGB+radar方法;只有雷达的估计器(距离最近的星团)在覆盖率90%时达到4.2%的相对误差,但尾巴很重。
(四) 雷达不取代LiDAR。 框级 LiDAR的准确度(0.052 vs. 0.120)仍然超过两倍,雷达的优势消失在30米(图6)以上,没有自己的雷达锚的动物继承了更不准确的帧级套装(leave-own-anchor-out AbsRel 0.239)。
我们还注意到对先前对这些数据的分析的更正:将雷达拉到LiDAR(最后一行)的锚需要LiDAR推断,并且不会大规模复制(AbsRel 0.572)。
当每帧外观用于地面真理而不是锚外观时,结论保持不变。

blocks.en: 5.4 Doppler as a Motion Cue (T4)
blocks.zh: 5.4 多普勒作为动因(T4)

blocks.en:
On the vehicle-mounted rig most Doppler is ego-motion: the per-frame cosine fit flags 35% of frames as ego-motion frames, which we exclude, leaving 12,596 static-platform frames that contain animals.
In these, Doppler above 0.5 m/s is associated with 8.5% of animal detections, concentrated in walking herds.
blocks.zh:
在车载钻机上,大多数多普勒是自负式:每帧的余弦能将35%的帧作为自负式的帧,我们将其排除在外,留下了12,596个包含动物的静态平台帧.
其中,0.5米/秒以上的多普勒与8.5%的动物检测相关,集中在行走群.

blocks.en:
In the 2,783 static-platform frames where an animal box contains at least three moving radar returns, transferring Doppler to single-sweep LiDAR (Sec. 4.3 ) multiplies the number of moving points by 3.7 × \times ; 72% of transferred moving LiDAR points fall on an animal, against 65% of the raw moving radar returns (Table 9 ).
Precision varies by sequence from 0.39 – where moving safari vehicles share the view – to 0.96–0.98 on walking camel herds (Fig. 7 ).
The anisotropic association radius is what makes the transfer dense: an isotropic 0.6 m radius yields only 1.75 × \times densification at the same precision.
Doppler and optical flow flag different animals (precision 0.57, recall 0.28 of radar against a flow motion label), as expected since radar measures radial and flow lateral motion.
blocks.zh:
在动物盒至少包含三个移动雷达返回的2,783个静态平台框中,将多普勒转移至单扫LiDAR(sec.4.3)乘以3.7×\时;转移的LiDAR点有72%落在动物身上,而原始移动雷达返回率为65%(表9).
精度依顺序而异,从0.39 — — 移动的游骑车与景色相同 — — 到步行骆驼群上的0.96–0.98 (图7).
异构结合半径是使转移稠密的原因:异构0.6米半径在同一精度下只产生1.75×\时的密度.
多普勒和光学流旗不同动物(精确度0.57,在流动标签下回顾0.28的雷达),这是自雷达测量光圈和流向横向运动以来的预期.

blocks.en: Table 9 : Doppler transfer from radar to single-sweep LiDAR (static-platform event frames). Densification = moving LiDAR points / moving radar returns; precision = fraction inside animal boxes.
blocks.zh: 表9:多普勒从雷达传输到单发LiDAR(静态-平台事件框架). 识别=移动LiDAR点/移动雷达返回;精度=动物盒内分数.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Doppler transfer. Sparse moving radar returns (left, projected with their elevation error) become a dense motion mask on the co-registered LiDAR (right) for walking camels.
blocks.zh: 图7:多普勒调剂。 Sparse移动的雷达返回(左,随着它们的高程误差投射)成为共同注册的LiDAR(右)上一个密集的运动面具,用于步行骆驼.

blocks.en: 5.5 Motion-Aware Densification
blocks.zh: 5.5 防控运动

blocks.en:
Temporal LiDAR accumulation gives dense, coherent surfaces for still animals (Fig. 11 ) but can smear moving ones.
We test whether Doppler gating (Sec. 4.3 ) helps, with identical LiDAR densification in all rows and per-pixel error measured against a held-out half of the current sweep (Table 10 ).
The answer depends on the accumulation window.
Over 0.5 s (5 sweeps), accumulation helps even moving animals and gating is unnecessary.
Over 1.5 s gating reduces the error on Doppler-flagged animals by 11%, and over 3 s by 37% (2.60 → \rightarrow 1.64 m), with gate precision rising from 0.54 to 0.85.
Across all animals at 3 s, an optical-flow gate is better than the Doppler gate (2.08 vs. 2.17 m) because it fires on more of the movers; Doppler is the more precise gate, and the only one that does not depend on illumination.
blocks.zh:
暂时的LiDAR积聚为静态动物(图11)提供了密集,连贯的表面,但可以涂抹移动的动物.
我们测试Doppler gating(Sec. 4.3)是否有帮助,所有行的LiDAR密度相同,每像素误差的测量值与当前扫荡的一半的悬空值相同(表10)。
答案取决于积累窗口.
超过0.5秒(5次扫荡),积聚甚至可以帮助动物移动,而食指是不必要的.
多普勒旗下动物的误差减少11%,超过3s的误差减少37%(2.60 →\右旋1.64米),门的精度从0.54升至0.85.
在3s的所有动物身上,一个光学流闸比多普勒门(2.08 vs 2.17 m)好,因为它向更多的移动器开火;多普勒是更精确的闸门,也是唯一不依赖于照明的闸门.

blocks.en: Table 10 : Doppler-gated LiDAR accumulation: dense-depth MAE (m) against held-out single-sweep LiDAR, by accumulation window. Gate precision = fraction of gated animals whose error decreases.
blocks.zh: 表10:多普勒加成的LiDAR积分:密密的MAE(m)对被搁置的单发LiDAR,按积分窗口排列. 门精度 = 门形动物的一小部分,其误差减少.

blocks.en: 5.6 Metric 3D Animal Tracking (T5)
blocks.zh: 5.6 计量三维动物追踪(T5)

blocks.en:
We now use these depth sources for the task a tracker must solve: turning 2D animal tracks into metric trajectories.
An IoU tracker links detections over all 19,716 frames; the 431 tracks with at least 20 observations (50,338 observations) are lifted to 3D with each depth source and smoothed with the same constant-velocity Kalman/RTS smoother, and the LiDAR-lifted track is the reference (Table 11 ).
blocks.zh:
我们现在利用这些深度源来完成一个追踪器必须完成的任务: 将2D动物轨迹变成测量轨迹。
一个IoU跟踪器在所有19,716帧上进行连接检测;至少20个观测(50,338观测)的431个轨道被提升到3D,每个深度源,并以相同的恒速卡尔曼/RTS平滑器平滑,LiDAR提升的轨道是参考(表11).

blocks.en: Table 11 : Metric 3D tracking on the radar subset (431 tracks). Errors against LiDAR-lifted trajectories (median over tracks); speed error on 169 tracks with reference speed > > 0.3 m/s; jitter = std of the raw frame-to-frame distance change; σ \sigma bias = bias of the half-normal detection-function scale fitted to per-track distances (distance sampling).
blocks.zh: 表11:雷达子集上的量子3D跟踪(431轨). 与 LiDAR 升起的轨距(轨距中间); 169 轨距的速率误差, 参考速度 > 0.3 m/s; jitter = std 的原始帧对帧距离变化;\\sigma 偏差 = 适合每个轨距的半正常检测功能尺度的偏差(距离采样).

blocks.en:
MoGe-2 alone places animals 2.2 m from their true position (distance AbsRel 0.149), and per-frame calibration from a single LiDAR point (UC) is far worse (6.3 m), because its frame-to-frame scale jitter (1.7 m) becomes spurious motion.
Per-frame scene-level LiDAR calibration reduces the error to 1.5 m.
Calibrating once per track is much better than calibrating every frame: a LiDAR scale taken from the first frame only gives 0.52 m.
Without any LiDAR, scaling MoGe-2 by the median radar/MoGe-2 ratio over the track gives 0.58 m position error, 3.3% distance error and 0.10 m/s speed error, matching the once-per-track LiDAR calibration and improving on MoGe-2 alone by a factor of four.
Radar range alone is equally accurate in position but twice as jittery (0.72 m).
blocks.zh:
仅MoGe-2就将动物从真实位置(距离AbsRel 0.149)放置在2.2米处,单立的LiDAR点(UC)的每帧校准更差(6.3米),因为其帧对帧大小的焦距(1.7米)变得不实运动.
每帧场景级LiDAR校准将误差降至1.5米.
每个音轨校正一次比校正每个帧要好得多:从第一个帧取出的LiDAR比例尺只给出0.52 m.
在没有任何LiDAR的情况下,通过中位雷达/MoGe-2比在赛道上缩放MoGe-2会给出0.58米位置误差,3.3%的距离误差和0.10米/秒的速度误差,匹配一次的每轨LiDAR校准,单在MoGe-2上就提升了4倍.
单是雷达射程在位置上同样准确,但比紧张(0.72米)高一倍。

blocks.en:
Distance-sampling abundance estimates depend on the distribution of detection distances [ 8 , 21 ] .
Fitting a half-normal detection function to per-track distances (Fig. 8 ), MoGe-2 alone underestimates its scale σ \sigma by 13% (the distance distribution differs from LiDAR’s, KS p < 10 − 6 p<10^{-6} ); with a per-track radar scale the bias falls to − - 2.1% and the distributions are statistically indistinguishable (KS p = 0.58 p=0.58 ).
blocks.zh:
远距离采样丰度估计数取决于探测距离的分布情况[8、21]。
将半正常的探测功能与每轨距离(图8)相匹配,仅MoGe-2就低估了它的标尺3/\sigma的13%(距离分布不同于LiDAR,KS p < 10 - 6 p < 10 > 6});如果每轨雷达的尺度,偏差下降到−-2.1%,分布在统计上是无法区分的(KS p = 0.58 p = 0.58)。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Per-track detection distances from LiDAR (grey), MoGe-2 alone, MoGe-2 scaled by radar per track, and single-point LiDAR calibration (UC).
blocks.zh: 图8:每轨距LiDAR(灰色),仅MoGe-2,MoGe-2按每轨雷达进行测距,单点LiDAR校准(UC).

blocks.en:
For 29,347 track observations with radar returns at the animal’s range, in-box Doppler correlates with the LiDAR range rate at r = 0.57 r=0.57 ( r = 0.61 r=0.61 on the static platform).
On moving animals (range rate above 0.3 m/s, n = 3,080 n=3{,}080 ) the correlation is r = 0.60 r=0.60 and the sign agrees 72% of the time, but Doppler under-reads the radial speed by about half (Theil–Sen slope 0.47, median error 0.29 m/s; Fig. 9 ), consistent with limb micro-Doppler [ 12 ] and static returns mixing into the box.
Doppler thus measures the direction and approximate magnitude of radial motion; it is a usable, if biased, velocity observation for a tracker.
The spread of in-box Doppler also increases with speed (Spearman 0.54), which suggests it as a cue for activity.
This corrects an earlier analysis of these data that reported no correlation.
blocks.zh:
对于29,347个有雷达在动物范围返回的轨道观测,框中的多普勒与LiDAR射程速率(r=0.57 r=0.57(r=0.61 r=0.61在静态平台)相关.
在移动动物(距离率高于0.3 m/s,n = 3 080 n = 3{,}080)时,相关关系为r = 0.60 r = 0.60,标志同意时间的72%,但多普勒下读射线速度约为一半(Theil–Sen 斜坡0.47,中误为0.29 m/s;图9),与四肢微多普勒[12]一致,静态返回混合在盒子中.
因此,多普勒测量射线运动的方向和大约规模;如果偏差的话,它是一种可用于跟踪器的速度观测。
箱内多普勒的传播也随着速度(Spearman 0.54)的提高而增加,这说明它是活动的提示.
这纠正了早先对这些数据所作的分析,这些分析没有相关内容。

blocks.zh: 图9:收件箱 Doppler对照LiDAR衍生的射程率(静态平台;每本中位数和方块间波段).

blocks.en: 5.7 Radar’s Operating Envelope for Wildlife
blocks.zh: 5.7 野生动物雷达操作信封

blocks.en: Elevation error dominates. Over 827k static radar returns matched to LiDAR, the radar extrinsic residual has a median of 0.10 m in the ground plane but 1.84 m vertically (Fig. 10 ); this is why per-pixel radar anchoring fails and every positive result above uses object-level association.
blocks.zh: 高度误差占主导地位。 超过827千米的静态雷达返回与LiDAR匹配,雷达外部残留的中位数为地面平面0.10米,但垂直为1.84米(图10);这就是每个像素雷达锚定失败的原因,上面的每一个积极成果都使用物体级关联.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Radar error budget. Left: residual of static radar returns to the nearest LiDAR point, in the ground plane (range/azimuth; matches gated at 1 m) and vertically. Right: radar–LiDAR timestamp offset.
blocks.zh: 图10:雷达误差预算。 左侧:静态雷达的剩余部分返回距离最近的LiDAR点,在地面平面(距离/azimuth;1米的门口匹配)和垂直. 右侧:雷达-LiDAR时间戳偏移。

blocks.en: No coverage extension and no foliage penetration. Moving radar returns without nearby LiDAR exist but are vehicles, foliage, or far clutter – none are animals after a depth-consistency check – and a search for animals seen through vegetation found only artefacts; the Longleat enclosures are open grassland, and the vegetated sites have no radar.
blocks.zh: 没有覆盖扩展和叶片穿透。 移动的雷达返回没有附近的LiDAR存在,而是车辆、叶片或远处杂乱无章的 — — 在深度一致性检查之后,没有一种是动物 — — 并且通过植被寻找只发现人工制品的动物;Longleat闭塞是开阔的草地,植被遗址没有雷达。

blocks.en: Doppler does not clean calibration anchors. Removing moving points from the anchors changes the calibration error by +0.01 m over 2,426 animals in an earlier analysis on 32 sequences.
blocks.zh: 多普勒不清理校准锚. 从锚上移除移动点会改变校准误差+0.01米,比2,426只动物早些时对32个序列进行分析.

blocks.en: Automatic RGB–LiDAR offset refinement fails. For the MorphoCam rig, maximizing agreement between LiDAR depth edges and RGB gradients over image shifts produced optima that tracked the search bound, and 11 of 13 scenes failed an independent in-mask spread check; edge agreement has no interior optimum on sparse LiDAR in natural scenes.
blocks.zh: 自动 RGB – LiDAR 抵消改进失败 。 对于MorphoCam钻机,在LiDAR深度边缘和RGB梯度对所生成的跟踪搜索约束的图像移的约定最大化,13个场景中的11个未能实现独立的内掩式扩展检查;边缘协议对于自然场景中稀疏的LiDAR没有内部优化.

blocks.en:
Per-frame extrinsic refinement can drift. The per-frame LiDAR → \rightarrow camera extrinsics of the CPS2 rig drift away from the sequence anchor by up to 25 ∘ ; where the drift exceeds 5 ∘ , the anchor extrinsic puts more than twice as many LiDAR points on the animal (116 vs. 50) with a tighter in-mask depth spread (0.83 vs. 1.27 m).
We therefore use the anchor extrinsic throughout (Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
每帧外观的精度可以漂移. CPS2钻机的直径摄像头从测序锚上漂移至25 °;如果漂移超过5 ° ° ,则锚在动物身上放置了两倍多的LiDAR点(116对50),更紧密的植入深度分布(0.83对1.27米)。
因此,我们全程使用锚(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: 5.8 Densification, Behaviour and 4D Reconstruction (from WildDepth)
blocks.zh: 5.8 认证、行为和4D重建(来自野外深度)

blocks.en: For completeness we summarize the remaining WildDepth baselines [ 1 ] . Densification: on a walking red hartebeest at ≈ {\approx} 97 m (Kgalagadi), MoGe-2 + LiDAR scale-shift alignment reaches positive R 2 R^{2} (0.25) where a planar fit does not ( − - 0.10), at similar MAE (Table 12 , Fig. 11 ). Behaviour: VideoMAE [ 53 ] classifiers over 12 activities and 20 fine-grained actions (per-class F1 in the supplementary material). 4D reconstruction: SAM2 masks with a Gaussian-splatting deformation field [ 17 ] (Fig. 12 ). Robustness to the MDE: repeating the anchor comparison with the diffusion-based Marigold [ 24 ] on a 233-frame subset leaves the conclusions unchanged (supplementary Table S1): with anchors, Marigold is on par with MoGe-2 (e.g. RC-box 0.131 vs. 0.137), but it is affine-invariant and cannot be used without an anchor.
blocks.zh: 为完整起见,我们总结其余野深基线[1]。 识别:在行走的红色猎犬上 97 m (Kgalagadi), MoGe-2 + LiDAR 缩放调式对齐达到正R 2 R^{2}(0.25),在类似的MAE(表12,图11)中,平面不合适。 行为:VideoMAE[53]对超过12项活动和20项精细动作进行分类(补充材料中每级F1). 4D重建:SAM2口罩带有高斯电镀变形场[17](图12). 对 MDE 的强性:重复主机在233帧子集上与基于扩散的Marigold [24] 比较,使结论保持不变(补充表S1): 有了主机,Marigold与MoGe-2(如RC-box 0.131 vs. 0.37)是等价的,但它是亲缘的,没有主机就无法使用.

blocks.zh: 图11:目标点密度:RGB(左)和密集的度量点云(右),为一头大象和一头狮子(长叶)和一头红色哈特贝底(Kgalagadi).

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Our results separate three roles that are often conflated.
As a dense depth sensor , radar is not (yet) competitive with LiDAR: it is much sparser on the animal and its vertical extrinsic error rules out per-pixel use. As radar MIMO antenna count increases with technological improvements, point cloud density and angular resolution will increase, making it a viable dense sensor.
As a scale anchor , it is genuinely useful: object-level radar range calibrates a monocular model better than scene-level LiDAR calibration, and on the three quarters of animals where it sees them its range is within 6% of LiDAR – on a sensor rig that costs and consumes a fraction of a LiDAR.
As a motion sensor , it measures something neither commonly available LiDAR nor a single image can: which returns are moving now, and in which radial direction.
Transferred onto LiDAR it gives dense motion masks, and it can decide when multi-second temporal fusion is safe.
blocks.zh:
我们的成果将经常被混为一谈的三个角色分开。
作为密集的深度传感器,雷达与LiDAR没有(尚未)竞争力:它比动物少得多,其垂直外部错误排除了每像素的使用。 随着雷达MIMO天线的计数随着技术的改进而增加,点云密度和角分辨率将增加,使其成为一个可行的密集传感器.
作为规模锚点,它真正有用:物体级雷达范围比场景级的LiDAR校准更能校准单体模型,在它看到它们的四分之三动物上,其范围在LiDAR的6%以内 — — 在一个耗资和消耗一小部分LiDAR的传感器钻机上。
作为运动感应器,它测量的东西既不是常用的LiDAR,也不是单一的图像不能:现在的返回正在移动,以及射线方向。
转移到LiDAR上,它会发出密集的运动面具,并且可以决定多秒时间聚变何时安全.

blocks.en:
For metric tracking, the temporal structure of depth error matters more than its per-frame average: a scale that jitters from frame to frame appears as motion.
Calibrating once per track rather than once per frame is therefore the single most effective choice – it reduced position error three-fold with LiDAR (1.52 → \rightarrow 0.52 m) – and radar makes it possible without LiDAR (0.58 m).
For ecological inference the consequence is concrete: monocular depth alone biases the scale of a distance-sampling detection function by − - 13%, which would inflate density estimates, whereas a per-track radar scale reduces the bias to − - 2%.
Doppler is a biased but informative velocity observation (r = 0.60, slope 0.47 on moving animals), suitable as a radial-velocity measurement in a tracker’s filter once the gain is calibrated.
blocks.zh:
对于度量跟踪,深度误差的时间结构比其每帧平均值更重要:一个从帧到帧的震动尺度显示为运动.
因此,每道校正一次而不是每帧校正一次是最有效的唯一选择——它用LiDAR(1.52 →\rightarrow 0.52 m)将位置误差减少了3倍,雷达使得没有LiDAR(0.58 m)成为可能.
就生态推论而言,后果是具体的:单光深度使测距功能的尺度偏差为−-13%,这将提高密度估计,而每轨雷达尺度则将偏差降至−-2%。
多普勒是一种偏颇但信息丰富的速度观察(r = 0.60,运动动物的坡度0.47),一旦收益被校准,就适合在跟踪器的过滤器中进行射线-速度测量.

blocks.en: Elevation resolution drives the dominant extrinsic error and blocks per-pixel radar–camera fusion; a static or ego-compensated mount matters because ego-motion swamped the Doppler in 35% of our frames; and extrinsic calibration should be validated against an independent signal – in our data the per-frame refined extrinsics drifted by up to 25 ∘ while their own optimization objective reported success. An approach to increasingly elevation angular resolution is to use a second radar (V) mounted orthogonally to the original radar (H). In addition, it should be noted that the Altos radar is optimized for automotive applications in terms of its modulation parameters and signal processing chain – a suggested next step would be to capture raw I/Q mmWave radar for custom signal processing.
blocks.zh: 高压分辨率驱动着主要的外部误差和每个像素雷达的阻断 — — 相机聚变;静态或自我补偿的挂载问题,因为自负运动将多普勒号淹没在我们35%的帧内;高压校准应针对一个独立的信号进行验证 — — 在我们的数据中,每帧精炼的外部振荡高达25 — — 而它们自己的优化目标报告成功。 越来越高地角分辨率的一种方法是将第二台雷达(V)垂直地装在原雷达(H)上。 此外,应当指出的是,阿尔托斯雷达在其调制参数和信号处理链方面对汽车应用进行了优化——建议采取的下一步是捕获原始的I/QmmWave雷达用于定制信号处理。

blocks.en:
Radar is available at one site, on one day, in daylight and in open enclosures; its illumination invariance and its behaviour in vegetation are observed rather than measured here.
The radar results are strongest below 30 m, where most of our animals are, and radar range becomes unreliable beyond it.
The best radar range estimator uses the monocular model’s metric prediction to select returns and is therefore an RGB+radar method; the purely radar estimator has a heavy tail.
The radar → \rightarrow LiDAR extrinsic is hand-refined on one sequence, and LiDAR ground truth inherits the calibration and synchronization errors we characterize rather than eliminate.
The tracking reference is itself LiDAR-derived and our tracker is a simple IoU tracker; identity-level metrics (HOTA, IDF1) require identity labels we do not yet have.
The hidden test set is in-domain (not session-disjoint), small in Track A (510 detections), and contains visible visitors and number plates that must be anonymized before public release.
blocks.zh:
雷达在一个地点、一天白天、白天和露天的闭塞中都可以使用;在此观察到其光线变异及其在植被中的行为,而不是测量。
雷达结果最强,在30米以下, 我们的大部分动物都在那里, 雷达范围变得不可靠 超过它。
最好的雷达测距器使用单光模型的度量预测来选择返回,因此是一种RGB+雷达方法;纯雷达测距器有一个沉重的尾巴.
LiDAR地面真理继承了我们所描述的校准和同步错误,而不是消除。
追踪参考材料本身就是LiDAR衍生的,我们的追踪器是一个简单的IoU追踪器;身份级别(HOTA, IDF1)需要我们还没有的身份标签.
隐藏的测试集是域内(不是会话-断开),小于轨道A(510检测),包含在公开发布前必须匿名的可见访客和数字盘.

blocks.en: A night-time RGB–thermal–radar collection (the CPS2 rig also carries a thermal camera) is the natural next step to measure the low-light regime that most motivates radar; identity-verified herd sequences would allow testing whether range and Doppler improve association; and a session-disjoint, multi-site hidden test would turn the benchmark into a generalization test.

blocks.en:
WildDepth-v2 extends WildDepth from a static RGB–LiDAR depth dataset to a benchmark for metric perception of animals over time.
It adds the first synchronized RGB–LiDAR–radar recordings of animals with a measured calibration and timing error budget, a frozen hidden test with a public scorer, and tasks for metric scale, motion segmentation, and 3D tracking.
Monocular depth models remain meters off at wildlife ranges without a metric anchor; radar supplies that anchor cheaply – enough to track animals in metric 3D and to remove most of the distance-sampling bias of monocular depth without LiDAR – and, through Doppler, adds a motion signal that LiDAR lacks, while its elevation error and attenuated Doppler set clear limits.
We release the data, calibration, benchmark, and code, and hope they help turn the millions of existing monocular wildlife images and tracks into metric measurements that ecologists can use.
blocks.zh:
Wild 深度- v2 扩展 Wild Depth从静态的RGB–LiDAR深度数据集到对动物随时间推移的度量感知基准.
它加入了第一次同步的RGB–LiDAR–radar记录动物,其测量的校准和计时误差预算,冷冻的隐藏测试与公共计分器,以及测量尺度,运动分割和3D跟踪的任务.
独角兽深度模型在野生生物群落中仍保持米径,没有固定的测量锚; 低价锚定的雷达供给 — — 足以在测量3D中追踪动物,并消除大部分没有LiDAR的独角兽深度的远距离取样偏差 — — 并通过多普勒增加了一个运动信号,即LiDAR缺乏,而其高程误差和减弱的多普勒则设定了明确的界限.
我们公布数据、校准、基准和代码, 希望它们能帮助把数百万的野生生物 图像和轨迹 变成生态学家可以使用的测量尺度。
